reason: I have refused cloud software for years out of fear of client data leaks, so I will not pay for a subscription until I verify that Docketra is strictly quarantined and cannot touch any outside client files. Even though retaining our own Google Drive and saving two hours on Saturday GST tracking sounds appealing, I will only test the free pilot first.
objection: Connecting any third-party tool to our Google Drive makes me anxious about confidential PAN and ITR records leaking, and my clients will still just dump unstructured bills on WhatsApp rather than following any system.
would_change_my_mind: Proven in-app cryptographic proof of zero external Drive access plus completely hands-off WhatsApp file ingestion directly into Drive without manual forwarding.
